class.name: Box3DPhysics
class.description: [Box3DPhysics] exposes Box3D-specific helpers, including the surface material registry and assignment/query methods. It is available as the [code]Box3DPhysics[/code] engine singleton.

method.name: body_set_surface_material
method.description: Assigns a named surface material id to one body shape, or all shapes when [param shape_idx] is [code]-1[/code]. Passing [code]0[/code] clears the body-level override.

method.name: get_face_material
method.description: Returns the baked surface material for [param face_index] on a shared mesh shape, or [code]null[/code] if none is assigned.

method.name: surface
method.description: Returns the surface material occupying slot [param id], or [code]null[/code] if that slot is unconfigured. This is the canonical way to reach a surface. Ids are the durable handle every baked reference stores — hit results, [Box3DSurfaceMap], [Box3DSurfaceOverride3D] — so a caller holding one reads whatever it needs off the returned resource rather than through a per-field accessor: [codeblock] var surface = Box3DPhysics.surface(hit.material_id) if surface: print(surface.material_name) var data = surface.gameplay [/codeblock]

method.name: get_material
method.description: Returns the material resource registered by integer id or [StringName], or [code]null[/code]. Prefer [method surface] when you have an id.

method.name: get_material_id
method.description: Returns the registered id for [param name], or [code]0[/code]. For authoring and migration only. Names are editable labels, so nothing durable should store one — resolve a name to an id once and store that.

method.name: get_material_name
method.description: Returns the registered name for [param id], or an empty [StringName]. Equivalent to [code]surface(id).material_name[/code], but safe when the slot is unconfigured.

method.name: get_material_names
method.description: Returns the names of every registered material, in library order.

method.name: get_materials
method.description: Returns every registered material resource, in library order. Entries the registry rejected (missing name, duplicate name or id) are omitted, unlike [method Box3DSurfaceMaterialLibrary.get_materials] which returns the raw authored array.

method.name: get_shape_mesh_material_indices
method.description: Returns the material-index array baked into a mesh shape.

method.name: get_surface_material_library
method.description: Returns the loaded project surface material library.

method.name: has_material
method.description: Returns whether a material named [param name] is registered.

method.name: match_texture
method.description: Returns the first registered material id whose texture pattern matches [param texture_name], or [code]0[/code].

method.name: reload_surface_material_library
method.description: Reloads the library from [code]physics/box3d/surface_material_library[/code]. Existing shapes use updated values after reassignment or rebuild.

method.name: recording_get_size
method.description: Returns the current native Box3D recording byte count for [param space], or [code]0[/code] when no recording buffer exists.

method.name: recording_is_active
method.description: Returns whether [param space] is actively recording native Box3D operations.

method.name: recording_save
method.description: Saves the last stopped native Box3D recording for [param space] to [param path]. Stop the recording before saving.

method.name: recording_start
method.description: Starts native Box3D recording for [param space]. [param byte_capacity] is an optional initial buffer size; [code]0[/code] uses Box3D's default.

method.name: recording_stop
method.description: Stops native Box3D recording for [param space] and returns the serialized bytes.

method.name: recording_validate
method.description: Replays serialized native Box3D recording bytes and returns whether all embedded state hashes match. Pass [code]1[/code] to match the module's current serial stepping.

method.name: recording_validate_file
method.description: Loads a native Box3D recording file and validates it with [method recording_validate].

method.name: shape_set_surface_map
method.description: Assigns a per-triangle material map to a shared mesh shape. [param triangle_indices] indexes [param material_ids].

method.name: shape_set_surface_material
method.description: Assigns a base material id to a shared shape. Passing [code]0[/code] clears the shared-shape override.

signal.name: surface_materials_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the surface material registry is rebuilt, including by [method reload_surface_material_library]. Inspector dropdowns and the Physics tab refresh from this instead of polling.
